commonFacts.route: Officially linked member hub; no account access/submission

awards.heading: LPA VOLAR Military Scholarship
awards.conditions: Active-duty military, reservists, veterans and military-affiliated applicants pursuing aviation or aerospace training. The page requests military identification; exact family-affiliation limits are not stated.

awards.heading: LPA Private Pilot Scholarship
awards.conditions: Private pilot training, current third-class medical and student pilot certificate; enrolled or planning to enroll in a Part 61 or Part 141 flight school.

awards.heading: LPA Advanced Rating Scholarship
awards.conditions: Commercial, multi-engine, instructor, ATP/CTP or selected type ratings. A current private pilot certificate is required for commercial training; a commercial certificate is required for the other listed advanced ratings.

awards.heading: LPA Professional Flight Degree Scholarship
awards.conditions: Enrollment in an accredited professional flight degree program; supports associated tuition, flight fees and training.

awards.heading: LPA Aviation Maintenance Technician Scholarship
awards.conditions: Airframe and Powerplant or Inspection Authorization training; enrolled or planning to enroll in an FAA-recognized A&P program.

awards.heading: EPIC Flight Academy Aviation Maintenance Technician Scholarship
awards.conditions: Age 18 or older, US citizen or permanent resident, high-school diploma or equivalent, and ability to relocate to New Smyrna Beach, Florida or Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky for the 19-month mechanic program. LPA lists$25000 for spring 2026; Epic’s later general sponsor page lists$35000 without the same cycle. Amount is left blank pending reconciliation.

awards.heading: LPA Aerospace Degree Advancement Scholarship
awards.conditions: Aerospace-related degree study, including engineering, business, maintenance, air traffic control, dispatch or technology. Flight training is expressly excluded.

awards.heading: United Aviate Academy Scholarship
awards.conditions: Age 18 or older; conditional acceptance to or current enrollment at United Aviate Academy. Funds go directly to the Academy and cannot be transferred. This is the LPA-sponsored program, not another organization’s UAA award.

awards.heading: 1STEP Prep ATP/CTP Scholarship
awards.conditions: Applicants in the Miami, Florida area; commercial pilot certificate with instrument rating; ATP-CTP preparation with 1 STEP. Travel and lodging excluded.

awards.heading: LPA Los Angeles Region Community Scholarship
awards.conditions: Applicants in the greater Los Angeles area with aviation/aerospace and community involvement.

awards.heading: American Airlines Dispatcher Certification Scholarship
awards.conditions: FAA Aircraft Dispatcher Certification training through the American Airlines partnership. Other certification prerequisites are not detailed on this scholarship page.

awards.heading: Elevated Access Advanced Rating Scholarship
awards.conditions: Fixed-wing pilot with private pilot certificate pursuing instrument, commercial or instructor certification; commitment to Elevated Access’s mission and an additional essay. Rotorcraft training is excluded.
